summary: American National Group Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events on September 15, 2026, disclosing a routine board declaration of a cash dividend on its 7.375% Fixed-Rate Non-Cumulative Preferred Stock, Series D. The dividend equals $460.9375 per Series D preferred share, equivalent to $0.4609375 per depositary share (each a 1/1,000th interest), payable October 15, 2026 to holders of record as of September 30, 2026. No special-situation transaction, advisor, premium, or structural mechanic is present; the filing is an ordinary preferred dividend announcement requiring no risk-arbitrage analysis.
